name: ai-session-analyzer
description: Analyze your local Claude Code sessions and generate a self-contained HTML report: productivity, tool usage, activity patterns, per-project comparison, and an AI-calibrated 'time saved / What-X-faster' estimate. Runs fully locally and uses your Claude Code session as the analysis engine.

session_data_path.title: Session data directory
session_data_path.description: Where Claude Code stores session JSONL files.

snapshot_dir.title: Snapshot directory
snapshot_dir.description: Where computed analysis snapshots are stored. Persisting them enables trends over time and incremental (iterative) build-up across runs.

report_dir.title: Report output directory
report_dir.description: Where generated HTML reports are written.
